blocks.text: Predicate logic propositional logic ki extension (aage barhi hui shakal) hai. Is se hum cheezon (objects) aur un ki properties (khoobiyon) ke baare mein zyada tafseeli statements likh sakte hain. Predicate logic mein hum afraad (individuals), groups aur un ke darmiyan rishton (relationships) ki baat kar sakte hain (Figure 2.7 dekhein).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure 2.7 mein predicate “Helps” (madad karta hai) hai aur us ke do variables x aur y hain. Mil kar Helps(x, y) banta hai, yani “x, y ki madad karta hai”. Jab x aur y ki jagah asal naam rakhein, maslan Helps(Ali, Sara), to yeh sach ya jhoot ho jata hai.

Predicate logic aise statements parhti hai jin mein variables aur predicates hon. Predicate aisa statement hai jo variables ki values ke mutabiq sach ya jhoot ho sakta hai. Maslan “x 5 se bara hai” predicate hai, kyunke is ka sach ya jhoot hona x par depend karta hai. Predicate logic se “Tamam students mehnati hain” ya “Kuch kitabein dilchasp hain” jaise statements likhe ja sakte hain. Yeh knowledge (ilm) ko formal (baqaida) tareeqe se likhne ke liye istemal hoti hai.
Propositional aur predicate logic mein farq

Propositional logic aise simple statements ke saath kaam karti hai jo ya sach hon ya jhoot. Yeh cheezon ki properties ya un ke rishte bayan nahi kar sakti. Doosri taraf predicate logic predicates aur variables istemal kar ke tafseeli statements likhti hai. Predicate logic propositional logic se zyada expressive (zyada baat bayan karne wali) aur taqatwar hai. Propositional logic samajhna aasan hai lekin us mein lachak (flexibility) kam hai. Predicate logic bohat si cheezon aur shartom ke baare mein statements likhne deti hai.

Predicates cheezon ki properties ya rishte bayan karte hain. Maslan “isEven(x)” tab sach hai jab x even (juft) number ho. Variables domain of discourse (jin cheezon ki baat ho rahi hai un ka group) ki cheezon ya values ko dikhate hain. Variables se hum aam statements likh sakte hain, jaise “For all x, x > 0” (har x ke liye, x zero se bara hai). Predicates aur variables mil kar predicate logic ke expressions banate hain, jo mushkil khayalat saaf aur formal tareeqe se bayan karte hain. Reasoning aur problem solving ke liye inhein samajhna zaroori hai.

Kahin zyada expressive (zyada baat bata sakti hai).

blocks.prompt: “Sara student hai” aur “Sara ko cricket pasand hai” predicates se likhein. Propositional logic kyun nahi dikha sakti ke dono baatein Sara ke baare mein hain?
blocks.explanation: Student(Sara) aur Likes(Sara, cricket). Propositional logic mein yeh P aur Q jaise do alag letters ban jate hain jo subject ko chhupa dete hain, is liye pata nahi chalta ke dono Sara ke baare mein hain aur us par reasoning nahi ho sakti.
